result.reviewScopeSummary: Verified Story 3 across process-scoped review target discovery, direct artifact review resolution, explicit version and zero-version handling, review-workspace bootstrap behavior, and the new server/client/integration coverage added for cross-process and pinned-context review paths.

newFindings.title: Artifact version selection failures still collapse the review workspace instead of reloading bounded target state
newFindings.evidence: `selectArtifactVersion` catches `ApiRequestError` from `getArtifactReview()` and only patches `reviewWorkspace.error` (`apps/platform/client/app/bootstrap.ts:1019-1141`); it never reloads `/review` with the same selection. `renderReviewWorkspacePage` then short-circuits on any non-null `reviewWorkspace.error` and returns a failure section before rendering `availableTargets` or a bounded unavailable target (`apps/platform/client/features/review/review-workspace-page.ts:223-236`). That means an `ARTIFACT_VERSION_NOT_FOUND` follow-up read loses the review target list and target-scoped degradation the Story 3 client design/test plan call for. The client tests added here only cover superseded success/error races (`tests/service/client/version-switcher.test.ts:127-301`), so this 404 recovery path remains unproven and currently incorrect.

mockOrShimAuditFindings: `apps/platform/server/app.ts:154-182` still falls back to `NullPlatformStore` when live Convex config is absent; that repo-wide shim leaves review surfaces empty outside configured runtimes, but it was not introduced by Story 3.
Reviewed Story 3 production paths do not add new mocks/fake adapters; `InMemoryPlatformStore`, test auth doubles, and fake browser transports remain confined to test-only surfaces.
additionalObservations: Server-side Story 3 behavior is well covered: cross-process artifact review, pinned package-context eligibility, zero-version omission from target discovery, bounded empty direct review, and exact `ARTIFACT_VERSION_NOT_FOUND` responses are all exercised in service and integration tests.
Both requested gates passed, but `guard:no-test-changes` and `test:e2e` are still scaffolded skip commands rather than substantive verification lanes.
